scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace @breditor/example-react
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:diagnostics && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:startup:diagnostics: npm run build && vite build --config vite.startup-diagnostics.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.startup-diagnostics.config.ts --project=webkit
scripts.test:property:diagnostics: npm run build && vite build --config vite.property-isolation.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.property-isolation.config.ts --project=webkit
scripts.test:number:diagnostics: vite build --config vite.number-transport.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.number-transport.config.ts --project=webkit
scripts.test:number:candidate: npm run build && vite build --config vite.numeric-normalization.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.numeric-normalization.config.ts --project=webkit
scripts.test:selection:stress: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.selection-stress.config.ts --project=webkit
scripts.test:selection:stress:production: npm run build && vite build --config vite.selection-stress.config.ts && playwright test -c playwright.selection-production-stress.config.ts --project=webkit
scripts.test:demo: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.demo.config.ts
scripts.test:demo:stress: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.demo-stress.config.ts --project=webkit
scripts.test:clipboard:stress: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.clipboard-stress.config.ts --project=webkit
